cases.question: My card payment was declined. How can I fix it?
cases.answer:
Card payment TX-CARD-001 was declined. Reason: the card was frozen.

Your card payment may be declined if your card is frozen or inactive. Open Cards, select the card used for the payment, and check its status. If it is frozen, follow the in-app steps to unfreeze it before trying again. Never share your PIN or card security code with support. [HELP-CARD-01]
